description: This file defines the Zend_Validate_Date class, which provides date validation functionality within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for setting date format and locale, and validating date strings against these parameters.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_Date
classes.description: A class for validating date strings against specified formats and locales within the Zend Framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the date validator with optional format and locale.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for date validation, validating that the locale is known.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the current date format setting.

methods.name: setFormat
methods.description: Sets the date format for validation.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates whether a given string is a valid date according to the set format and locale.
